newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Allegany County, Md.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Allegany County, Md.

text.p: County Commissioners of Allegany County, Maryland

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that County Commissioners of Allegany County (the County'') will receive written sealed bids for the $6,680,000 Public Improvement Bonds of 1997 (the Bonds'') until 11:00 a.m. local Baltimore, Maryland time on:
at the offices of Piper & Marbury L.L.P., Conference Room 7A, Seventh Floor, 36 S. Charles Street, Baltimore,

Maryland, 21201. The Bonds will be dated March 1, 1997 and will mature on March 1 in the years 1998 through 2012 as more fully described in the Notice of Sale. No bid for less than all of the Bonds will be considered.

The Bonds will be awarded based on the lowest cost to the Service, determined in accordance with the true interest cost (TIC) method. All bids must be accompanied by a good faith deposit in the amount of $133,600, payable to the order of County Commissioners of Allegany County.
The Bonds which mature on or after March 1, 2008 are subject to redemption prior to maturity as provided in the Notice of Sale.

Payment of the principal and interest on the Bonds when due will be insured by a municipal bond insurance policy to be issued by AMBAC Indemnity Corporation simultaneously with the delivery of the Bonds.
The County will not designated the Bonds qualified tax- exempt obligations'' pursuant to Section 265(b)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended.

Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement and the Notice of Sale and form of proposal relating to the Bonds may be obtained from the office of the Director of Finance, Allegany County, Maryland, 701 Kelly Road Cumberland,
Maryland 21502-3401, or from H.C. Wainwright & Co., 100 East Pratt Street, Baltimore, Maryland 21202 (410-347-3900).
